rules.description: Applicant must have a record of employment with HMRC
rules.reason_if_failed: No employment record found. You can only request a P45 if you were employed and paid through PAYE.

rules.description: Employment must have ended (leaving date recorded)
rules.reason_if_failed: Your employment appears to be ongoing. A P45 is only issued when you leave a job.

rules.description: P45 must not have already been issued by the employer
rules.reason_if_failed: Our records show your employer has already issued your P45. Contact your employer if you have not received it.

rules.description: Request must be within 4 years of leaving employment
rules.reason_if_failed: You can only request P45 information for the last 4 tax years. For older records, contact HMRC.

edge_cases.description: Employer is no longer trading or has entered administration
edge_cases.action: Route to HMRC specialist team. P45 information will be generated from PAYE records without employer involvement.

edge_cases.description: Dispute about employment dates or whether employment ended
edge_cases.action: Route to HMRC compliance team. May require evidence of employment termination (redundancy letter, resignation acceptance, etc.).

edge_cases.description: Applicant has multiple concurrent employments in the tax year
edge_cases.action: Clarify which employment the P45 request relates to. Each employment generates a separate P45.

edge_cases.description: Employer has history of not issuing P45s or PAYE non-compliance
edge_cases.action: HMRC will issue P45 information directly and may investigate employer for PAYE compliance.
